subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native clients preserve bounded PNG inputs as PNG across Android picker, Apple chat, and iOS share, or retain or narrow the established JPEG-normalization policy?
rationale: Current tests define JPEG normalization as intentional behavior, while this PR changes format fidelity, transparency, compression, and downscaling tradeoffs across multiple native products; source review cannot choose that permanent user-facing policy.

options.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
options.body: Approve PNG retention across all three native entry surfaces, contingent on real-device gateway proof and acceptable quality under the existing byte budgets.

options.title: Preserve only alpha PNGs
options.body: Keep PNG only when transparency would be lost and continue JPEG normalization for opaque or photo-like PNGs to reduce severe downscaling.

options.title: Retain JPEG normalization
options.body: Keep the established transport policy if predictable size and uniform encoding outweigh source-format fidelity.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
recommendation.body: Approve PNG retention across all three native entry surfaces, contingent on real-device gateway proof and acceptable quality under the existing byte budgets.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes a shared product policy across independently owned Android and Apple surfaces, making the project owner the best available final arbiter.
